name: DCSServerBot
summary: Standalone server-management bot for DCS with monitoring, auto-restart, statistics and optional Discord integration.
description:
Standalone Python application run alongside DCS servers (install.cmd / run.cmd), not loaded in missions. Provides monitoring, player/server stats, tournaments and plugins for SRS, LotAtc and Tacview; works with or without Discord.

Requires: Requires Python 3.11-3.14, PostgreSQL, optional Git; Discord bot token for the Discord version; modifies MissionScripting.lua.
